boundaries.only_semantic_data: call0001-stdout; stderr always diagnostic original, never a second semantic parser
boundaries.identity: Exact source ID SRC-11/command invocation and G5-03 item order; reject all forged, duplicated, unknown subcalls, source_paths or cross-run originals
boundaries.json: Strict UTF-8 object with sole key blockdevices, array; each record object with approved keys NAME,KNAME,TYPE,SIZE,RO,RM,MODEL,SERIAL,TRAN plus optional children array; nested depth limited to 16, total nodes <=4096, strings bounded <=8192, no duplicate keys or nonfinite constants. Preserve values as reported; do not invent field presence, identity, disk model or runtime capacity
boundaries.privacy: Model and SERIAL fields remain PRIVATE canonical, are subject to publication masking, never public raw pointers
boundaries.output: One typed ARRAY datum storage.lsblk.blockdevices representing validated hierarchy and original values; no child capacity aggregation or partition-type inference

cases.expectation: Fixed JSON blockdevices tree with disk and partition, both original evidence SHA and matching parent-child labels; one semantic ARRAY from stdout
stdout and stderr both sealed; stderr classified diagnostic-only, valid zero exit yields COMPLETE/OK for semantic stdout, no false PARSE_FAILED
empty blockdevices array valid; do not invent block devices
nonzero D1 with one stdout uses owner-approved PARTIAL/SOURCE_INCOMPLETE, actual exit code preserved; no false COMPLETE
wrong stdout/stderr order, forged call0002 or duplicate, bogus invocation, forged source_paths reject before manifest
malformed JSON, duplicate keys, arrays not objects, forbidden field names, null root, NaN, excessive depth/count/size produce actual parser failure and fallback original
cross-run evidence/digest mismatch and missing stdout CAPTURED are refused before manifest
unexpected fields (e.g. mountpoint/uuid/owner) were not selected by exact command and must not be silently published
serial/model are private opaque strings, null and absent fields stay distinct; no raw-source pointer in generated public output
the accepted decoder preserves size as reported under --bytes; no automatic reinterpretation of textual numeric values
